Wall Mounted Tai Chi Towel Rings

text.description_html:
Fusion TR-F3, Tai Chi Trim Towel Ring

The Bamboo Tai Chi Towel Ring is easy to install. Mount one near the sink in both the bathroom and the kitchen to keep those hand towels off the counter. The bamboo embellishments make this hand towel holder a perfect accessory for homes with Asian decor. It has a medium bronze finish.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-F3 Tai Chi Towel Bar, Fusion PH-F3 Tai Chi Toilet Paper Holder, and Fusion RH-F3 Tai Chi Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Tai Chi Series Towel Ring:

  • Finish: Medium Bronze
  • Mount Diameter: 2-3/4"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
